wins.text: Q4 revenue of $22.1B, up 265% YoY and 22% sequentially, well above the $20B guidance outlook
Data Center revenue of $18.4B in Q4, up 409% YoY and 27% sequentially, with compute revenue growing more than 5x YoY
Non-GAAP gross margins expanded to 76.7% in Q4 on strong Data Center mix and favorable component costs
Software and services offerings reached an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion in Q4, with NVIDIA AI Enterprise priced at $4,500 per GPU per year
Returned $9.9B to shareholders in fiscal 2024, including $9.5B in share repurchases; $2.8B returned in Q4 alone

risks.text: China Data Center revenue declined significantly following U.S. export control regulations imposed in October 2023; China now only a mid-single-digit percentage of Data Center revenue and expected to remain so in Q1
Next-generation products (H200, Blackwell) expected to be supply constrained as demand far exceeds supply, limiting near-term revenue capture
Gross margins expected to decline from Q4/Q1 peak of ~77% back to mid-70s range for the remainder of fiscal 2025 due to product mix shifts
Large cloud providers represent more than half of Data Center revenue, creating meaningful customer concentration risk
Fiscal year 2025 GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses expected to grow in the mid-30% range, reflecting significant reinvestment pressure on earnings

guidance_items.detail: Q1 FY2025 total revenue guided to $24B +/- 2%, well above prior Q4 actuals of $22.1B and prior $20B Q4 guidance
Q1 non-GAAP gross margins guided to 77% +/- 50bps; remainder of FY2025 expected to return to mid-70s range
FY2025 GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses expected to grow in the mid-30% range as NVIDIA invests in large opportunities ahead

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential inventory buildup and whether purchased GPUs are actually being deployed/turned on by customers
Specifics of how NVIDIA fairly allocates scarce product across competing customers and industries
Breakdown and composition of the $1B software revenue run rate and go-to-market mechanics of NVIDIA AI Enterprise
